rules.name: is_style_colocated
rules.instructions: Does this stylesheet style COMPONENT behavior via global selectors? Component behavior (hover/active/disabled/selected states; presentation of buttons, rows, triggers) must be styled at the component (Tailwind classes on the element). Global element or attribute selectors - button:not(:disabled), [data-slot=...], .component-class rules that set behavior states - are a second style authority and a violation. NOT violations: @theme token definitions (palette, spacing), base document styles (body, html), non-behavioral resets, and theme assignments to vendor token classes (.hljs-comment etc.).

criteria.true: The file contains at least one global element/attribute selector that styles component behavior (e.g. button:not(:disabled), [data-slot="button"], a .component class setting hover/selected/active states).
criteria.false: No such selector: only @theme tokens, base document styles, non-behavioral resets, and vendor-class theme assignments.

rules.name: is_literal_shared
rules.instructions: In a TypeScript file, when the same literal value (string, number, regex) flows as DATA to two or more behavior sites, the file should define it once as a shared constant (const) and reuse that name: the same filename, url, storage key, message, size, or threshold written out raw at each site is drift waiting to happen. Judge the FILE, and be conservative: answer true only when you can point to ONE specific value appearing raw at TWO OR MORE distinct behavior sites (a value read or sent, a path joined, a message thrown/logged, a timeout, a magic number in logic). NOT data, never violations: prop values (variant="secondary"), event-type strings ("keydown"), Tailwind class strings, test selectors, sort keys and mode names ("rule"/"desc"/"warn"), typeof-guard strings (typeof x === "string"), encoding names used at read calls ONLY IF a const would not carry meaning, and trivial literals (0, 1, -1, empty string). If every repetition is one of those vocabularies, or each value appears at just one behavior site, answer false.

criteria.true: At least one semantic value (message, url, key, size, threshold, config constant) appears in two or more places as a raw literal, and the file defines no single const carrying it.
criteria.false: No repeated raw data values: every value used as data more than once flows through one named constant; remaining repetitions are vocabulary (prop values, event names, class strings, trivial literals) or single-use.
